slice: PHASE 13 S2d: short-channel sampler dispatch and dense layer mask
conditions: Fresh Release Editor processes; each variant has 3 runs, 30 warmup and 120 sampled frames per actor population; paused Play CPU-only product probe, 8 workers, profiling recording not requested; worker-sum overlaps wait and is not OS CPU time; GPU and presentation excluded
percentileMethod: nearest rank over 360 frames per actor population
interpretation: The temporary product-path linear call isolates the cached sampler as the source of most of the earlier Walk worker regression. Removing redundant writes alone did not retain its benefit after the dense-mask build; code generation and instance layout changed. The final short-channel dispatch recovers most of the regression on this fixture. It does not establish the optimal threshold for other clips or multi-layer mask performance.
